## Biography

The Python is a multi-role starship manufactured by Faulcon DeLacy, widely regarded as one of the most versatile vessels available to independent pilots. Its balanced performance and generous internal compartments have made it a popular choice for trading, mining, combat, and exploration. The Python name is also associated with the Python Mk II, a later variant developed around Achilles Aerospace's Supercruise Overcharge Frame Shift Drive.
